charts.title: TOI-7265 B b: orbits around TOI-7265 B
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-7265 B's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-7265 B b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Premnath et al. 2026 (2026AJ....172...92P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PREMNATH_ET_AL_2026): P 4.17232 d
